verdict.rationale: The evidence shows GitLab has issues and milestones. The GitHub importer brings in issues and milestones, agents and Chat work on project issues, and GitLab describes itself as covering 'planning' through CI/CD. No first-party issue-tracking documentation is in the pack, and time tracking and issue dependencies are never mentioned. Missing for 10: evidence of time tracking, evidence of issue dependencies or blocking links, first-party docs on issues and milestones, and hands-on corroboration of tracking requirements, features and bugs.
